# Expectation Maximisation

## Minoriser-Maximisation

**Minoriser-Maximisation** is a class of iterative optimisation methods useful for convex objective functions. 

Say we have a concave function $f$ that we want to maximise. Magically, we have some way of computing a local surrogate function $g(\theta| \theta^{(i)})$ that gives us a given the value of the current iterate $\theta^{(i)}$.
